questions.stem_text:
Which branch of Judaism founded by Zacharias Frankel is known for its "Positive-Historical
Judaism"?

Ashford argues that worries about causing dependency on aid agencies among those in
extreme poverty does not mean that we should

options.A: suggest that aid agencies are the only solution to global poverty.
options.B: abandon the world's poor to their unjust predicament.
options.C: argue that aid agencies are inherently unjust.
options.D: increase the amount of aid given to the world's poor.
options.E: ignore the issue of global economic justice.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - suggest that aid agencies are the only solution to global poverty.

questions.stem_text: An important formal characteristic of art is_____.

options.B: its power to evoke strong emotions

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the artist's nationality

questions.stem_text: When it comes to defining good, Moore claims that many past philosophers are guilty of:
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the naturalistic fallacy.

questions.stem_text: One message that Nathanson argues we can send by abolishing the death penalty is that

options.A: we believe in the possibility of redemption and change.
options.B: there are some penalties worse than death.
options.C: we are unable to administer justice effectively.
options.D: there is no punishment that is proportional to murder.
options.E: there is always a possibility of judicial errors.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - we believe in the possibility of redemption and change.
